# HELP snapraid_array_health Array health state (pending=0, passed=1, corrupt=2, degraded=3, prefail=4, failing=5)
# TYPE snapraid_array_health gauge
snapraid_array_health 0

# HELP snapraid_build_info Daemon and engine version info (always 1)
# TYPE snapraid_build_info gauge
snapraid_build_info{daemon_version="2.1",engine_version="15.1"} 1

# HELP snapraid_array_block_size_bytes SnapRAID block size in bytes
# TYPE snapraid_array_block_size_bytes gauge
snapraid_array_block_size_bytes 262144

# HELP snapraid_array_data_disks_count Number of configured data disks
# TYPE snapraid_array_data_disks_count gauge
snapraid_array_data_disks_count 2

# HELP snapraid_array_parity_disks_count Number of configured parity disks
# TYPE snapraid_array_parity_disks_count gauge
snapraid_array_parity_disks_count 1

# HELP snapraid_array_extra_disks_count Number of configured extra disks
# TYPE snapraid_array_extra_disks_count gauge
snapraid_array_extra_disks_count 0

# HELP snapraid_array_files Current count of tracked files (gauge snapshot, not a counter)
# TYPE snapraid_array_files gauge
snapraid_array_files 364

# HELP snapraid_array_blocks Total number of blocks in the array
# TYPE snapraid_array_blocks gauge
snapraid_array_blocks 500

# HELP snapraid_blocks_bad Number of bad blocks detected
# TYPE snapraid_blocks_bad gauge
snapraid_blocks_bad 0

# HELP snapraid_blocks_unsynced Number of blocks not yet synced to parity
# TYPE snapraid_blocks_unsynced gauge
snapraid_blocks_unsynced 0

# HELP snapraid_blocks_unscrubbed Number of blocks not yet scrubbed
# TYPE snapraid_blocks_unscrubbed gauge
snapraid_blocks_unscrubbed 450

# HELP snapraid_blocks_rehash Number of blocks scheduled for rehash
# TYPE snapraid_blocks_rehash gauge
snapraid_blocks_rehash 0

# HELP snapraid_last_command_timestamp_seconds Unix timestamp when the latest command run started
# TYPE snapraid_last_command_timestamp_seconds gauge
snapraid_last_command_timestamp_seconds{command="sync"} 1792940521
snapraid_last_command_timestamp_seconds{command="scrub"} 1792940522
snapraid_last_command_timestamp_seconds{command="diff"} 1792940521
snapraid_last_command_timestamp_seconds{command="fix"} 1792940557

# HELP snapraid_diff_files File diff counts from the last diff run by change type
# TYPE snapraid_diff_files gauge
snapraid_diff_files{change="equal"} 364
snapraid_diff_files{change="added"} 0
snapraid_diff_files{change="removed"} 0
snapraid_diff_files{change="updated"} 0
snapraid_diff_files{change="moved"} 0
snapraid_diff_files{change="copied"} 0
snapraid_diff_files{change="relocated"} 0
snapraid_diff_files{change="restored"} 0

# HELP snapraid_config_sync_threshold_deletes Sync delete threshold (0 = disabled)
# TYPE snapraid_config_sync_threshold_deletes gauge
snapraid_config_sync_threshold_deletes 20

# HELP snapraid_config_sync_threshold_updates Sync update threshold (0 = disabled)
# TYPE snapraid_config_sync_threshold_updates gauge
snapraid_config_sync_threshold_updates 50

# HELP snapraid_config_scrub_percentage Percentage of array scrubbed per scrub run
# TYPE snapraid_config_scrub_percentage gauge
snapraid_config_scrub_percentage 5

# HELP snapraid_config_scrub_older_than_days Only scrub blocks older than this many days (0 = ignore)
# TYPE snapraid_config_scrub_older_than_days gauge
snapraid_config_scrub_older_than_days 0

# HELP snapraid_config_spindown_idle_minutes Spin down disks after this many idle minutes (0 = disabled)
# TYPE snapraid_config_spindown_idle_minutes gauge
snapraid_config_spindown_idle_minutes{kind="data"} 0
snapraid_config_spindown_idle_minutes{kind="parity"} 0

# HELP snapraid_config_probe_interval_minutes Interval between probe commands in minutes (0 = disabled)
# TYPE snapraid_config_probe_interval_minutes gauge
snapraid_config_probe_interval_minutes 0

# HELP snapraid_config_hold_off Hold-off state
# TYPE snapraid_config_hold_off gauge
snapraid_config_hold_off 0

# HELP snapraid_disk_health Per-disk health state (pending=0, passed=1, corrupt=2, degraded=3, prefail=4, failing=5)
# TYPE snapraid_disk_health gauge
snapraid_disk_health{disk="d1",role="data"} 0
snapraid_disk_health{disk="d2",role="data"} 0
snapraid_disk_health{disk="parity",role="parity"} 0

# HELP snapraid_disk_transient_error Session errors per disk (cleared after clean scrub)
# TYPE snapraid_disk_transient_error gauge
snapraid_disk_transient_error{disk="d1",role="data",kind="io"} 0
snapraid_disk_transient_error{disk="d1",role="data",kind="data"} 0
snapraid_disk_transient_error{disk="d2",role="data",kind="io"} 0
snapraid_disk_transient_error{disk="d2",role="data",kind="data"} 0
snapraid_disk_transient_error{disk="parity",role="parity",kind="io"} 0
snapraid_disk_transient_error{disk="parity",role="parity",kind="data"} 0

# HELP snapraid_task_queue_depth Number of tasks queued (pending)
# TYPE snapraid_task_queue_depth gauge
snapraid_task_queue_depth 0

# TYPE snapraid_tasks_history_size gauge
snapraid_tasks_history_size{command="probe",status="terminated",health="passed"} 1

snapraid_tasks_history_size{command="start",status="terminated",health="passed"} 6
snapraid_tasks_history_size{command="up",status="terminated",health="passed"} 6
snapraid_tasks_history_size{command="sync",status="terminated",health="passed"} 4
snapraid_tasks_history_size{command="scrub",status="terminated",health="passed"} 2
snapraid_tasks_history_size{command="report",status="terminated",health="passed"} 6
snapraid_tasks_history_size{command="scrub",status="canceled",health="passed"} 2
snapraid_tasks_history_size{command="fix",status="terminated",health="passed"} 2

# HELP snapraid_task_last_exit_code Exit code of the most recent terminated task per command
# TYPE snapraid_task_last_exit_code gauge
snapraid_task_last_exit_code{command="probe"} 0
snapraid_task_last_exit_code{command="read"} 0
snapraid_task_last_exit_code{command="start"} 0
snapraid_task_last_exit_code{command="up"} 0
snapraid_task_last_exit_code{command="sync"} 2
snapraid_task_last_exit_code{command="scrub"} 0
snapraid_task_last_exit_code{command="report"} 0
snapraid_task_last_exit_code{command="fix"} 0

# HELP snapraid_task_last_duration_seconds Duration in seconds of the most recent terminated task per command
# TYPE snapraid_task_last_duration_seconds gauge
snapraid_task_last_duration_seconds{command="probe"} 0
snapraid_task_last_duration_seconds{command="read"} 0
snapraid_task_last_duration_seconds{command="start"} 0
snapraid_task_last_duration_seconds{command="up"} 0
snapraid_task_last_duration_seconds{command="sync"} 0
snapraid_task_last_duration_seconds{command="scrub"} 0
snapraid_task_last_duration_seconds{command="report"} 0
snapraid_task_last_duration_seconds{command="fix"} 0

# HELP snapraid_task_last_errors Error counts from the most recent terminated task per command and error kind
# TYPE snapraid_task_last_errors gauge
snapraid_task_last_errors{command="sync",kind="soft"} 0
snapraid_task_last_errors{command="sync",kind="io"} 0
snapraid_task_last_errors{command="sync",kind="data"} 0
snapraid_task_last_errors{command="scrub",kind="soft"} 0
snapraid_task_last_errors{command="scrub",kind="io"} 0
snapraid_task_last_errors{command="scrub",kind="data"} 0

snapraid_task_last_errors{command="fix",kind="unrecoverable"} 0

snapraid_task_last_errors{command="fix",kind="io"} 0
snapraid_task_last_errors{command="fix",kind="data"} 0

# HELP snapraid_exporter_last_pulse Pulse counter value per subsystem from the daemon
# TYPE snapraid_exporter_last_pulse gauge
snapraid_exporter_last_pulse{subsystem="array"} 117
snapraid_exporter_last_pulse{subsystem="config"} 2
snapraid_exporter_last_pulse{subsystem="disks"} 137
snapraid_exporter_last_pulse{subsystem="tasks"} 488
snapraid_exporter_last_pulse{subsystem="activity"} 561

# HELP snapraid_daemon_uptime_seconds Seconds the daemon has been running
# TYPE snapraid_daemon_uptime_seconds gauge
snapraid_daemon_uptime_seconds 280

# HELP snapraid_exporter_up 1 if the daemon is running and serving metrics
# TYPE snapraid_exporter_up gauge
snapraid_exporter_up 1
